summary: Hyatt Hotels Corporation filed a preliminary Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement on November 2, 2026 for an offering of senior notes due 20__, sized and priced at blanks in this preliminary document. Terms remain incomplete: principal amount, coupon, maturity, redemption make-whole and par call dates, and settlement date are unfilled. The notes are unsubordinated unsecured obligations ranking pari passu with existing unsecured debt, with a change-of-control repurchase covenant; no listing is planned. J.P. Morgan, US Bancorp and Wells Fargo Securities are joint book-running managers. This is an ordinary debt shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch final pricing, coupon and use of proceeds.
